source_en: Permit. Right. Force of habit. The gauze came off last week.
The skin grew around the edges. The grinding was never from the shop.
The hunger got very specific. Like I told you it would.
Pavle, step back from the window.
In a moment. I've been looking forward to this.
Something fresh. I've been very patient.
You were always very good to me. You'd make a {{very clean cut}}.
